[[Legends Classic (basketball tournament)|Legends Classic]] champions |bowl = [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = round of 32 }} {{2014–15 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2014–15 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Villanova University]] in the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Jay Wright (basketball)|Jay Wright]] in his 14th season, the Wildcats participated as members of the [[Big East Conference]] and played their home games at [[Finneran Pavilion|The Pavilion]], with some select home games at the [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]]. They finished the season 33–3, 16–2 in [[2014–15 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to win the Big East regular season championship. They defeated [[2014–15 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]], [[2014–15 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]], and [[2014–15 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] to win the [[2015 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2015 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 1 seed in the East Region. They defeated Lafayette in the Second Round before being upset in the Third Round by [[2015–16 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]]. The Wildcats set a single-season school record for wins with 33. == Previous season == The [[2013–14 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|2013–14 Villanova Wildcats]] finished the season with an overall record of 29–5, with a record of 16–2 in the Big East regular season to capture their Big East regular season title. In the [[2014 Big East men's basketball tournament|2014 Big East tournament]], the Wildcats were upset by [[2013–14 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]], 64–63 in the quarterfinals. They were invited to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] which they defeated [[2013–14 Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball team|Milwaukee]] in the second round before getting eliminated by eventual NCAA Tournament Champion [[2013–14 Connecticut Huskies men's basketball team|Connecticut]] in the third round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
